fun Merge(array, left, mid, right):
    n1 = mid - left + 1
    n2 = right - mid

    leftArr = arr(n1)
    rightArr = arr(n2)

    for (i = 0, i < n1, i += 1):
        idx = left + i
        @mark<idx, outline, yellow> leftArr[i] = array[idx]
    end for

    for (j = 0, j < n2, j += 1):
        idx = mid + 1 + j
        @mark<idx, outline, yellow> rightArr[j] = array[idx]
    end for

    i = 0
    j = 0
    k = left

    while (i < n1 and j < n2):
        @mark<k, outline, yellow> if (leftArr[i] <= rightArr[j]):
            @mark<k, text, fg> array[k] = leftArr[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            @mark<k, text, fg> array[k] = rightArr[j]
            j += 1
        end if
        k += 1
    end while

    while (i < n1):
        @mark<k, outline, yellow> array[k] = leftArr[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1
    end while

    while (j < n2):
        @mark<k, outline, yellow> array[k] = rightArr[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1
    end while
end fun

fun Merge_Sort_Helper(array, left, right):
    if (left < right):
        mid = floor((left + right) / 2)
        Merge_Sort_Helper(array, left, mid)
        Merge_Sort_Helper(array, mid + 1, right)
        Merge(array, left, mid, right)
    end if
end fun

fun Merge_Sort(@init<table> array):
    n = length(array)
    Merge_Sort_Helper(array, 0, n - 1)
    return array
end fun
